selected_branches.branch: Extreme-right-hand-lane duty on a one-way multilane highway.

law_text: If any driver or operator of a motor vehicle drives or operates a motor vehicle at a speed so slow as to impede the forward movement of traffic proceeding immediately behind the driver or operator, the driver or operator shall: If the highway has two or more clearly marked lanes for traffic traveling in the direction in which the driver or operator is traveling, drive in the extreme right-hand lane except when necessary to pass other slowly moving vehicles.

witness_review.branch: Extreme-right-hand-lane duty on a one-way multilane highway.
required_context: Establish driver attribution and qualifying motor-vehicle classification.
Establish highway status and at least two clearly marked lanes in the subject's direction.
Establish qualifying highway, motor-vehicle scope and driver or operator attribution.
Place a distinct other vehicle immediately behind and retain its movement relative to the subject.
Record lane ordering, subject occupancy and any passing-related vehicles and circumstances.
Record subject lane occupancy and both vehicles' positions, speeds, separation and forward movement.
Retain any other slowly moving vehicles and circumstances relevant to necessary passing without assigning that judgment.
Specify at least two clearly marked same-direction lanes and their ordering.
witness_review.reason: The fixed one-way multilane geometry supports multiple same-direction lanes; clear markings and the speed interaction must be established.
